pages.text: The first shattered vial starts the world's outbreak clock; the five stages begin on outbreak days 0, 1, 3, 7 and 14 by default. Servers can change the thresholds. Later stages allow more mature hosts, hunters and airborne infected. Local habitat, loaded chunks and population limits still affect encounters.

City districts track local infection and military presence. Destroying a hive can suppress its neighborhood. Scout another district for hosts or supplies and watch the sky. Use a field scanner to check for nearby infected.
